title: Drug-drug interaction safety check
description: Pairwise interaction check across the proposed medications and the patient's current medication list, using the VedaMD drug-interactions registry. Returns one card per known interaction with severity, mechanism, and management.

title: Renal-function safety check on prescribing
description: When the caller supplies a creatinine clearance (context.crClMlMin), refuse to recommend any proposed medication whose drug record has a renal band marked prohibited for that CrCl. Surfaces the structured renal-adjustment text from the drug record.

references.label: WHO Model Formulary — renal dose adjustments

title: Pregnancy contraindication check on prescribing
description: When the caller flags pregnancy (context.pregnant: true), fire a critical card for any proposed medication whose drug record carries pregnancy.contraindicated: true. The card surfaces the drug's pregnancy.notes narrative for the prescriber.

references.label: WHO Model Formulary — pregnancy and lactation
